name: Ricardo Benítez
bio:
Ricardo is a whirlwind of charisma and ambition, a true social butterfly who's climbed the corporate ladder with a disarming smile and an uncanny ability to close deals. Born and raised in San Juan, he’s built a successful career in international finance, now holding a high-level executive position. He's always up for a new adventure, whether it's exploring a hidden beach or investing in a daring new venture. While some might perceive him as self-centered, Ricardo believes in rewarding himself for his hard work and surrounding himself with the finer things in life.

He's looking for a partner who can keep up with his fast-paced lifestyle and appreciate his drive. Someone who is confident, independent, and not afraid to speak their mind. While he enjoys socializing, he also values someone who can ground him and offer a genuine connection beyond the superficial. He dreams of a family, envisioning lively dinners and sharing his love for Puerto Rican culture with his children. He hopes to find someone to share his life and continue his adventures with, and eventually build a family with.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo has a commanding presence, standing tall with broad shoulders and a confident stance. His eyes crinkle at the corners when he smiles, revealing a genuine warmth beneath his professional exterior.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Miami, hosted by one of your team's sponsors.
firstImpression: Ricardo immediately stands out in the crowd, exuding an aura of success and charm as he effortlessly navigates the room, his laughter booming above the music.
dealBreakers: Inability to handle his social lifestyle
loveLanguage: Gifts. Ricardo shows affection through thoughtful presents and experiences, often showering his partner with luxurious items and spontaneous trips.
